title: Select Screen Social
tagline: Dynamic event banner images for lens publications, that update with attendee profile pictures based on NFT claims
description: This project is a dynamic banner or 'character select screen' for panel discussions, hackathon teams and other jam sessions. We use lens protocol to create a container and then opt into it by claiming NFTs. As participants claim NFTs the banner or 'character select screen' auto updates and fills in with their profile picture. This enables socially verified event participation or in the future mutisig event/session unlocking.
how_its_made:
This project intended to use Lens protocol to issue a publication that acts as a dynamic banner with spaces for participant profile pictures. We use the Lens NFT module to offer places within the banner and as these are claimed by participants the publication banner gets dynamically updated with their profile pictures.  
At the moment the technical specifications are verified, but due to some unforeseen circumstances, we hadn't finished the implementation workflow (repo is a landing page atm)
